svg.text: VISIONASSIST AI — ENHANCED ENTITY-RELATIONSHIP (EER) CONCEPTUAL SCHEMA
Comprehensive Conceptual & Logical Data Architecture for Voice-Guided Assistive Testing & Multi-Person Proctoring Subsystem

g.text: FORMAL ENHANCED ENTITY-RELATIONSHIP (EER) NOTATION & DESIGN CONVENTIONS
Single solid rectangle: Regular entity with independent existence (e.g. USER, EXAM, RESULT)
Double rectangle: Existence-dependent entity relying on parent primary key (QUESTION, ANSWER_LOG)
Single diamond: Standard relationship with (1:N) or (M:N) cardinalities and participation constraints
Double diamond: Identifying relationship linking weak entity to its owner entity
Disjoint Specialization (d): An entity instance can belong to at most one subclass (Student OR Teacher OR Admin)
Primary Key (PK): Solid underline — unique identifier for entity instances
Partial Primary Key (PPK / Discriminator): Dashed underline — identifies weak entity instances in owner scope
Multivalued Attributes: Encapsulated in braces / double ellipses (e.g. {options}, {languages})
VisionAssist AI | Authors: NAYANA N S & LAKSHMI K | Department of Computer Science & Engineering
